Dynamic Digital is hiring a Junior Full Stack Developer to build, maintain, and enhance client websites, landing pages, and interactive web applications. The role works with designers, project managers, and senior developers to turn design mockups into performant, reliable code and support client projects through launch.

Responsibilities
Build, customize, and maintain WordPress websites, including custom themes, child themes, and ACF (Advanced Custom Fields) implementations
Develop modern front-end interfaces using modern JavaScript (ES6+) and component frameworks (e.g., React or Vue)
Integrate third-party APIs, marketing automation tools (e.g., HubSpot, Klaviyo), analytics scripts, and third party webhooks
Implement responsive designs strictly adhering to Figma or Adobe XD design files across mobile, tablet, and desktop breakpoints
Assist in diagnosing and resolving cross-browser bugs, performance bottlenecks, and CMS-related technical issues
Follow established version control workflows (Git) and deployment processes
Collaborate daily in-person with project managers, SEO specialists, and creative teams to meet project and launch deadlines
Handle daily support requests by understanding, replicating, and addressing issues in the application

Required
0–2 years of hands-on web development experience (agency internship, junior role, or strong demonstrable project portfolio)
Strong foundational understanding of HTML5, modern CSS3/SCSS, and vanilla JavaScript (ES6+)
Understanding of the WordPress template hierarchy, PHP basics, theme customization, and working with custom post types and fields
Exposure to at least one modern framework or library (React, Next.js, Vue, or similar)
Familiarity with Git/GitHub, local development environments (LocalWP, Docker, or XAMPP), and build tools (Vite, Webpack, or npm scripts)
Strong problem-solving skills, willingness to take constructive code reviews, and ability to balance code quality with agency project turnaround times
Ability to use AI development tools for efficiency in code creation
Ability to evaluate AI created code for quality and knowledge verification
Preferred
Basic understanding of SEO best practices, page speed optimization (Core Web Vitals), and accessibility standards (WCAG)
Experience with WooCommerce or Shopify theme customization
CI/CD pipelines
Hosting, DNS, and server migration
Benefits
4-Day Work Week (Monday – Thursday, 10 hour days)
Hybrid - 3 days on-site in Willow Grove, PA / 1 day remote (WFH)
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage after 90 days
Paid Time Off (PTO), paid holidays, and sick days
